terms.example: The coating masks a bitter taste.

terms.definition: Solid particles dispersed in a liquid.
terms.example: Shake the suspension before use.

terms.definition: A mixture of two liquids that do not normally mix.
terms.example: The cream is an oil-in-water emulsion.

items.title: 3 Pharma Technology English words in 30 seconds: coating, suspension, emulsion #Shorts
items.caption:
• coating /ˈkəʊtɪŋ/ = bao phim / bao viên
• suspension /səˈspenʃən/ = hỗn dịch
• emulsion /ɪˈmʌlʃən/ = nhũ tương

terms.definition: A channel through which qi is believed to flow.
terms.example: This point lies on the stomach meridian.

terms.definition: Burning dried mugwort near the skin.
terms.example: Moxibustion was applied to the point.

terms.definition: Applying cups to the skin to create suction.
terms.example: Cupping left round marks on his back.

items.title: 3 Traditional Medicine English words in 30 seconds: meridian, moxibustion, cupping #Shorts
items.caption:
• meridian /məˈrɪdiən/ = kinh lạc
• moxibustion /ˌmɒksɪˈbʌstʃən/ = cứu ngải
• cupping /ˈkʌpɪŋ/ = giác hơi
